title: How to Use Coupon Codes and Never Miss a Discount
excerpt: A quick, practical guide to finding, revealing and applying promo codes so you save on every online order.
author: Editorial Team
body:
## Finding a working code
Start by searching the store on TheSmartFares. We test codes daily and show a success rate on each one, so you can pick the offer most likely to work.

## Revealing and copying
Click "Get Code" to reveal the code. It's copied with one tap and the store opens in a new tab, so you can paste it straight into the checkout.

## Applying at checkout
Look for a field labelled "Promo code", "Coupon" or "Discount". Paste your code and apply it before you pay — the total should drop instantly.

## Tips to save more
- Try more than one code; keep the biggest discount.
- Stack a coupon with a seasonal sale where allowed.
- Check the expiry date and terms on the store's site.

title: 10 Money-Saving Beauty Hacks That Will Transform Your Routine
excerpt: Simple, practical beauty hacks that cut your spending without cutting corners — stretch products further and save on every purchase.
author: Editorial Team
body:
## Why your beauty routine costs more than it should
Between skincare, makeup and haircare, small purchases add up fast. The good news: most of that spending is avoidable without giving up the products you love.

## 10 hacks that actually save money
- **Water down thick formulas.** Shampoo, body wash and liquid foundation often work just as well diluted with a little water — stretching each bottle further.
- **Double-duty products win.** A tinted moisturizer with SPF replaces three steps with one, cutting both cost and clutter.
- **Buy travel sizes to test first.** Skip the full-size gamble on new products; a travel size confirms it works before you commit.
- **Use the "upside down" trick.** Store bottles cap-down between uses so every last bit reaches the opening instead of sitting unused.
- **Repurpose old products.** Dry lipstick becomes a cream blush; leftover conditioner works as a shaving cream substitute.
- **Shop off-season.** Sunscreen, self-tanner and heavy moisturizers are marked down when demand drops.
- **Master multi-masking with one product.** Use a single clay mask on oily zones and a hydrating one on dry zones — no need for two full products.
- **Set a price-per-use mindset.** A $40 product used daily for a year costs about 11 cents a day — often cheaper than a $12 product you'll toss half-used.
- **Sign up before you buy.** Many beauty retailers offer a first-order discount just for creating an account.
- **Always check for a code before checkout.** A quick look for a verified promo code can shave 10-30% off an order in seconds.

## Where to find the codes
Before you check out at any beauty or wellness retailer, search the store on TheSmartFares — verified codes are hand-tested daily, so you're not stuck with an expired one at checkout.
